dedupe_keys.name: catalogo y mapa de carreteras de castilla la mancha

description: Catálogo y Mapa de Carreteras de Castilla - La Mancha is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. The current configuration of the Autonomous Community Network is reflected in the ‘Catalogue of the Autonomous Community Road Network of the Autonomous Community of Castilla-La Mancha’, which has recently been updated and approved by Decree 18/2024 of 2 April 2024. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. The portal shows the English title as "Catalogue and Map of Roads of Castile - La Mancha" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. Its keywords include Red autonómica, Carreteras, Red de carreteras, Catálogo. The listing shows 6 download or service links in SHEET, SPREADSHEET, HTML, CSV. The listing shows 2024-11-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/es/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
